narrative.overview:
Food Rescue Network treats surplus coordination as a live signal: food is reported, matched, dispatched, and verified across one readable chain. The interface uses a warm work-surface neutral as its desk, ink typography as the control-room readout, and a green signal that becomes amber or red only when attention is needed.

The system is operational rather than ornamental. Cards are quiet containers for decisions, mono labels provide telemetry, and the recurring meter motif gives realtime status a memorable visual language.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper surfaces with grounded ink text.
Green active signal, amber attention, red urgent state.
Compact shadcn controls with Phosphor iconography.
VU-meter telemetry as the signature visual, not decoration.

rules.name: The Signal Rarity Rule
rules.body: Green is a live operational signal, not a blanket decoration; reserve amber and red for their meaning.

rules.name: The Token-Only Rule
rules.body: Product UI never introduces page-level hex, RGB, or ad-hoc color utilities. Extend the global semantic vocabulary instead.

rules.name: The Two-Register Rule
rules.body: Use Jakarta for human decisions and explanations; use JetBrains Mono for operational state, never for long-form reading.

rules.name: The Desk-Depth Rule
rules.body: Use tonal layering first, a quiet border second, and a small shadow only when a surface needs separation from the workbench.

dos: Do use global semantic tokens for every product surface and state.
Do compose forms from shadcn Field, FieldGroup, FieldError, and the appropriate control primitive.
Do use Empty for zero states, Alert for errors and important callouts, Progress for measurable progress, and Badge for compact status.
Do preserve keyboard focus, readable labels, reduced motion, and mobile stacking.
donts: Don't introduce gradients, glow-heavy effects, page-local palettes, or generic dark dashboard chrome.
Don't use raw HTML controls where a shadcn primitive exists.
Don't use Lucide, emoji, or mixed icon libraries; use Phosphor with the configured shadcn icon contract.
Don't present illustrative impact numbers as verified operational facts.
Don't use animation to communicate information that is not also available as text.
